name: Amos
author: Amos, a herdsman from Tekoa.
setting: Prosperous Israel ignores the poor and worships falsely.
theme: God demands justice and true worship, and promises to restore David’s house.

outline.label: Judgment on the nations and Israel
Syria, Philistia, Tyre, Edom, Ammon, Moab, and Judah
A lament and a call to seek the LORD
Locusts, fire, and the plumb line

christInBook: Amos looks forward to restoring David’s fallen tent (9:11-12), which James quotes at the council in Jerusalem to explain the Gentiles’ inclusion (Acts 15:15-18). Christ is the one who fulfills justice.
howToRead: Amos is a shepherd from Judah speaking to the north. Notice how he begins with judgment on the neighbors and then turns to Israel itself. The book ends in hope.
